summary: Ellomay Capital Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting its unaudited interim financial results for Q2 2026. The filing notes a net profit of 94.8 million, including a capital gain from the sale of indirect holdings in Dorad Energy Ltd., but this is a routine earnings report, not a special-situation event. No M&A, tender offer, activist campaign, or other special category is triggered by the filing itself. The registrant is reporting its own financials, so its role is that of filer. The sale of Dorad holdings is mentioned in passing, but the filing does not provide deal terms or a transaction announcement.
